applies_to: Mark Airstream air handling units controlled by an OJ Electronics OJ-Air2 Master controller.
summary: Mark's Airstream AHU manual reproduces the OJ Electronics OJ-Air2 Master register list, with a Modbus address and a BACnet object for each parameter. The controller is a BACnet IP device (B-AAC) on its RJ45 Ethernet port. This list holds the 878 parameters that have a BACnet object (AI, AV, BI, BV); rows with NA in the BACnet column are Modbus-only and left out. Every value is readable whatever the unit's options, but it is only used when the matching component or sensor is installed.
firmware: OJ Air2 program version 4.18 or later (BACnet section)
notes: Access follows the object group headings: Analog/Binary value (R/W), Analog/Binary input (R).
Min/max and the [1/100 °C] or [1/100 %] scaling in descriptions come from the shared Modbus/BACnet table; the doc does not say whether BACnet values are scaled.

The table prints AV304 twice: for Humid_SupSet (humidity setpoint, Modbus 4x0228) and for RecMaxFresh (Modbus 4x0359). Only RecMaxFresh is listed here, since it follows AV302/AV303 in sequence; check Humid_SupSet on a live unit.
Some names print with a space (e.g. 'ZM1 RoomTmpSet', 'BMS InpStat'); they are kept as printed.
Flow points read in l/s, m3/h or CFM depending on the unit selected in the controller.

source.title: Manual tehnic Modbus Bacnet - Mark Airstream AHU (OJ Air2 Master Modbus/BACnet)

integration.summary: Run the unit from the BMS with AV244 BMSDrfCtrlReg (11 = stop, 105 = low, 414 = medium, 210 = high speed), which only works once the physical 'Operating mode via BMS' input is active (BI199 BMS InpStat reports it). Write the temperature setpoint to AV134, read AI0 DriftMode for the actual mode, the supply and outdoor temperatures and flows, BI29 for any active alarm, and pulse BV0 to reset alarms.

integration.enable: AV244 BMSDrfCtrlReg sets the BMS operating mode (11 stop, 105 low, 414 medium, 210 high, 211 summer night cooling, 220 night heating). BMS modes only take effect after the physical input 'Operating mode via BMS' is activated; BI199 BMS InpStat reports the BMS-control activation status. AV0 ManDriftMode is the controller's own auto/manual/calendar selection.
integration.remote_sensors: To use a BMS outdoor temperature set BV15 MBTOutDAct and write AV245 MBT_OutDoor; for room temperature set BV16 MBTRoom1Activ and write AV246 MBT_Room1. Alarms flag BMS room and outdoor values that are out of range.
setup: BACnet IP on the RJ45 port, UDP 47808.
The device instance is set automatically from the last 5 digits of the controller's IP address (e.g. 172.21.0.95 gives 95), only at power-up or restart.
Up to 300 values can be subscribed for COV at once.
gotchas: Writing AV244 does nothing until the 'Operating mode via BMS' digital input is active.
Changing the IP address changes the device instance after the next restart.
Many AVs are commissioning settings (pump modes, alarm limits); keep cyclic BMS writes to the command and setpoint points.
Rows with NA in the BACnet column are Modbus-only and are not in this list; a few BACnet objects have no Modbus register.
